notes.title: No More Heroes 3 Ver. 1.10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We have released a new update for No More Heroes 3 that applies the following changes:

- Rendering quality in cutscenes and open world maps has been improved to be equivalent to the latest Microsoft Store version of No More Heroes 3. This includes improved textures, sharper backgrounds, and draw distances.
- View Distance option has been added to Graphic Settings menu.
